discoveredNodes.label: RuntimeJobObserver
discoveredNodes.reason: R2 N22 ProviderObserver was too broad. Carrier readiness and Runtime Job evidence come from different authorities and have different retry/effect semantics; R5 keeps Runtime Job observation at the Runtime seam rather than merging it with carrier observation.

authorityLaws: Agent Task identity is not Runtime Job identity.
Runtime status=succeeded is mechanical evidence, not Task semantic completion.
Runtime must project semanticCompletionEvaluated=false; Agent Service owns semantic verification.
Assignment owns a durable Runtime clientRequestId before Runtime admission.
Response loss before runtimeJobId persistence replays the same Runtime operation identity.
Task terminal state and Task semantic event commit atomically.

acceptanceScope.evidenceSource: Runtime retained stdout tail plus terminal mechanical fields
